_about: Scientific data library, domain circulation: the universal columns of the game's body/data/circulation.json tables, written by scripts/split_data.py. Same columns/rows schema as the game's tables. `id` is stable (see README); `source` holds source keys from sources.json ('; ' separated) or 'open'. Mark is the review state of these columns. A null in a column the engine's data/*.json holds by the same id means the engine file is the home of that value.

quantities.title: The blood: composition and transport quantities (ChatGPT's requirement 3)
quantities.source: Standard values: blood volume about 70 mL/kg (men) 65 (women); haematocrit about 45% red cells, 55% plasma; haemoglobin 13.5 to 17.5 g/dL men, 12 to 15.5 women; each gram carries 1.34 mL oxygen; arterial content about 20 mL/dL; resting cardiac output about 5 L/min (stroke volume 70 mL x 70 beats), maximum 20 to 25 in the trained; oxygen delivery DO2 = CO x CaO2 x 10, about 1,000 mL/min at rest; platelets 150 to 400 x10^9/L; sodium 135 to 145 mmol/L, potassium 3.5 to 5.0, calcium 2.2 to 2.6; glucose 4 to 6 mmol/L fasting; pH 7.35 to 7.45. delivery_failures.title: Three ways oxygen delivery fails, told apart (anaemia, haemorrhage, dehydration) and what fixes each
delivery_failures.source: DO2 = CO x 1.34 x Hb x SaO2 x 10: each failure takes a different term. events.title: Conditional cardiovascular events (never a random roll on a healthy body)
events.source: Atherosclerosis develops over years (lipids, pressure, tobacco, the sugar sickness, age, inflammation damaging the endothelium); infarction follows plaque rupture or erosion with a clot blocking coronary flow (CIR-MI); arrhythmias follow electrolyte disturbance (potassium under 3.0 or over 6.0), hypoxia, drugs (NEUROLOGY: alcohol withdrawal, stimulants, quinine at high dose), scarred heart muscle; sudden death in a young crew is rare and usually structural (the one with the hidden heart). The chance formulas are placeholders; the shape is the clinical one. Rex, 2026-10-29: named characters are vulnerable to these events; all the events the biology supports are in; a failure is a crisis, never a death by itself (ANATOMY 3a).

homeostasis.title: Regulation loops the circulation runs (the feedback the audit asked for)
homeostasis.source: Baroreflex (pressure down: rate and resistance up within seconds), the kidney's long-term pressure and volume control (hours to days), the kidney's red-cell signal (days to weeks), glucose by insulin and glucagon (minutes), temperature by skin perfusion and sweat (PHYSIOLOGY), acid-base by breathing and kidneys. Each loop is a target, a sensor and a correction with a time constant; the organs that run them must have function for the loop to work.

blood_gas.title: Blood gases: oxygen binding, carbon dioxide, carbon monoxide, acid-base
blood_gas.source: Severinghaus 1979: SaO2 = 1 / (1 + 23400 / (PaO2^3 + 150 PaO2)) (P50 about 26.8 mmHg at pH 7.4, 37 C; the curve shifts right with acidosis, fever and CO2, left with alkalosis, cold and carbon monoxide); carboxyhaemoglobin by the Coburn-Forster-Kane model, simplified here to a first-order approach to equilibrium with a 4 to 6 h half-life in air (CIR-SEV, CHM-CO); CO2 carried as bicarbonate, pH by Henderson-Hasselbalch (standard).
rows: low inspired oxygen; lung transfer failing
Severinghaus: 1 / (1 + 23400 / (PaO2^3 + 150 PaO2)); shifted by pH, temperature and CO2
under 0.90 breathless and dull; 0.80 confused, blue; 0.70 unconscious; under 0.60 death in minutes
dCOHb/dt = (COHb_eq - COHb) x ln2 / t_half, COHb_eq about 0.16 x ppm / 100 (an approximation valid to a few thousand ppm), t_half 5 h in air (uptake faster at work: x VE/6)

10 to 20% headache and nausea; 20 to 30% drowsy, ataxic, impaired; 30 to 50% seizures, unconscious, the heart starves; over 50% death. Oxygen content falls by the COHb share and the curve shifts left (the rest is held tighter): worse than the same loss of haemoglobin
CaO2 = 1.34 x Hb x (1 - COHb) x SaO2 + dissolved
the pulse and the colour look normal (cherry pink): the surgeon cannot tell
set by ventilation against production: PaCO2 = 0.863 x VCO2 / alveolar ventilation
over 50 drowsy, over 70 narcosis; under 30 (panic, hyperventilation) tingling and faintness
pH from bicarbonate and PaCO2 (Henderson-Hasselbalch); respiratory acidosis with CO2 retention, alkalosis with over-breathing; metabolic acidosis from shock and lactate (CIRCULATION 1)
under 7.2 the heart weakens; over 7.6 tetany
not a blood-gas problem: it poisons the cells' use of oxygen (cytochrome oxidase) like cyanide; blood looks oxygenated while the tissues starve
